title: Reliability-Dubois2024
description: Time-domain functional near-infrared spectroscopy (TD-fNIRS) recordings collected with the Kernel system to assess the reliability of brain metrics derived from this device. The dataset accompanies a Scientific Reports study evaluating the test-retest reliability of TD-fNIRS measures. It is mirrored on NEMAR from OpenNeuro (ds006545).
methods_description: Data were acquired using a Time-Domain Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy System. The dataset is organized according to BIDS standards (version 1.6.0) and includes raw fNIRS measurements.
